prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1160; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the injured party in connection with the rear-end collision described in the claim file. Our client was struck from behind while stopped in traffic and has sustained injuries that are currently under medical evaluation. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We ask that you provide the full liability limits of the policy held by your insured, together with any declarations page and information on any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please also confirm in writing the claim number assigned to this matter and the name of the adjuster handling the file.

Finally, we request that your company preserve all evidence relating to the collision. This includes photographs, vehicle data and event recorder information, repair estimates, recorded statements, dash camera footage if any exists, and all internal notes and claim records. Routine deletion or disposal of any such material should be suspended until this matter is fully resolved.
